subject_line: Corrected claim and reconsideration - Victor Almeda - Claim PCA-2025-0943317 - 29876-XS-RT
key_arguments: Line 2 is corrected to 29876-XS-RT; the original claim omitted the distinct-procedure modifier.
RP-114 Section 4 allows separate reimbursement when the synovectomy is in a separate compartment and documented.
The op note documents synovectomy of the suprapatellar pouch, patellofemoral compartment and lateral gutter only, separate from the medial meniscectomy.
